title: The Fever and Antipyretic in Critically Illness Evaluation Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this multination multicenter observational study is to determine the impact of fever and antipyretic on outcomes in critically ill patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult non-neurological critically ill patients (20 years old or older).
* ICU patients expected to require intensive care for more than 48 hour.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with brain injury (suspected or proven)
study_population: Adult non-neurological critically ill patients required intensive care for more than 48 hour.
